name: Improved Coup de Grace
body:
Your combat experience and knowledge of opponent’s weak points enables you to deliver faster, more effective coup de grace attacks.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Expertise, Heal 8 ranks

Benefit: Attempting a coup de grace attack does not provoke an attack of opportunity. If your target survives your coup de grace attack he must make a Fortitude save (DC 15 plus damage dealt) or die.

Normal: Attempting a coup de grace attack provokes an attack of opportunity. If your target survives the attack he must make a Fortitude save (DC 10 plus damage dealt) or die.
